TRUE ORTHOPEDIC SUPPORT - Solid 41"X27"X4" top rated gel infused temperature regulating memory foam provide the support and relieves the pain of arthritis, will not flat overtime to promote better sleep and healthy joint.

MORE THAN JUST A NORMAL BED - Incredible support with conforming therapeutic comfort, less allergens and cooler sleeping surface allowing your pet to get the rest that they deserve. It will also fit into 42X28 or 28x42 inches crate.

MACHINE WASHABLE COVER - Comfort Microfiber Suede cover with strong zipper in gusset style and extra stitching to prolong the life of the bed, wash after wash. Best quality you'll find in orthopedic dog beds.
HIGHEST QUALITY - Premium materials, quality construction and smart features providing many years of comfort and support with excellent value for your money. Try it yourself and you will love it too.

The bed is durable, with one customer noting it holds its shape well after 6 months, and fits perfectly in dog crates while being suitable for large breeds like Turkish Akbash. Customers appreciate its waterproof inner cover and easy-to-clean removable cover, and consider it good value for money.

authors_reviews.title: Good purchase!
authors_reviews.text: This is a super dog bed. My in-laws have an orthopedic DogBed4Less bed at their house that my dog uses when she visits. She appears to like it. We decided to get one for our house. Our dog is a golden retriever so we went with the XL. The bed at my in-laws house is bigger than the current XL size offered, so I'm disappointed that it is smaller than I want. But the quality of the bed is really nice - the covers and the foam inserts appear to be well made. I wish there were more variety in color. I'm pleased to report that the foam doesn't smell, which was a concern.
authors_reviews.author: Samantha

authors_reviews.title: Great for my old girl with arthritis, hip dysplasia and anxiety
authors_reviews.text: My baby girl was a rescue, so we don’t know what her circumstances were before us but she is a nervous girl who likes to hide in blankets and sleep. She is 7 and has hip dysplasia and arthritis. When we first got her, she only wanted to sleep in bed with us or on the couch with tons of pillows. We wanted to get her a bed where she could easily get on and off and relax. She was hesitant at first, but she LOVES this bed. She’s 35 lbs and we got a large and she’s able to stretch out and cuddle with her favorite pillows and stuffed animals with them on the bed. She sleeps through the night on this and doesn’t want to leave it most of the time. We have to coax her with treats to get her off the bed to go potty. This is perfect for older dogs who just wanna stretch out. The memory foam is great quality and even when I sit on the bed with her it pops right back up and is just as good as the memory foam topper we have on our mattress. I want her to be comfy, and this bed makes her very comfortable and is her safe haven. I recommend it very much!
authors_reviews.author: Jane

authors_reviews.title: Excellent
authors_reviews.text: We've had one for nearly a year for our German Shepherd Dog and it's just as it was when we bought it. The memory foam is just as cushiony and firm. The cover has no damage or wear. The cover is easy to remove, wash, dry and out back on. The second waterproof cover inside is a great feature. Our dog loves the bed. It fits perfect in his crate, which is his safe space. Right after we got it for him, the calloused he had on his elbows began going away. I highly recommend this dog bed.
authors_reviews.author: romperstompers

authors_reviews.title: Great bed for our older border collie
authors_reviews.text: Our Bailey is 11 years old and has really benefited from this dog bed. I had no problems with zippers. I placed an old shirt I had recently worn on top of the bed which I believe helped her accept it right off. Bailey has arthritis in her "elbows", and the soft support the bed gives her relief when laying on it. I recommend this dog bed for anyone in a similar situation with their pet.
authors_reviews.author: Craig S

authors_reviews.title: great dog bed
authors_reviews.text: my two dogs share a kennel during the day while we are at work and one of them has allergies really bad in all seasons. having a comfortable bed for her (10.5 yrs old) that i can easily wash the cover is great! it also has a waterproof liner under the cover before the foam so any accidents do not damage the foam bed. being able to purchase spare liners and covers are a really big selling point for me and why i chose this bed for my two dogs. highly recommend, very well made
authors_reviews.author: Chris F.

authors_reviews.title: Nice, but very firm

authors_reviews.author: Sandra C Preci

authors_reviews.title: Forget egg crates and orthopedic foam, this 100% memory foam is where it's at!
authors_reviews.text: So happy with this purchase! I was weighing the idea of splurging on a Barker Bed, but the price... ouchhh!! I took a gamble on this bed with 4" thickness. They memory foam is of exceptional quality! It came in a oddly small box, but expanded instantly. It has two covers, one that's almost impenetrable and waterproof to protect the foam, and then a soft microsuede cover. I wish I bought this 3 dog beds ago! Great quality for the cost, and I'm certain it's going to hold up well!
authors_reviews.author: H Renee

authors_reviews.title: Love these beds...now I own 3 of them.
authors_reviews.text: I bought my first dog bed from them to keep in the back of my SUV for my 3 large dogs. One dog that comes to work with me daily. It fits the back of my Buick Enclave like a glove. If they have any accidents or anything gets spilled I just unzip the cover and wash it. It's super easy! I loved it so much that I bought another for under my desk for the dog that I take to work everyday. Then when he needed TPLO surgery my retired parents agreed to rehab him for a few months, so I bought another bed to keep at their house during his recovery. When I brought it back to my house my 3 kittens became obsessed with it. It was a dog bed and now it's a cat bed. They sleep on it 24/7...they even wrestle around on it. I did have an issue with it though...I washed it once and the zipper came unattached to the bed at the seam almost all the way around the bed. I contacted Dogbedsforless directly and they immediately sent me out a new cover free of charge. It's perfect! And the kittens are very happy! Great customer service!!!!
authors_reviews.author: Michele Blasi
